tail:
Batch 3 Step-5 authoring is complete.

- Authored 94 draft items and four page files.
- All 80 proof-bearing items pass precheck; 14 definitions correctly use `n/a`.
- Proof contracts: 80/80 clean, with 124 exact citations and 640 non-template boundary dispositions.
- Plan, content policy, coverage, rendering, prose, forward-reference, and external-dependency gates pass.
- No items were dropped, narrowed, renamed, judged, audited, or published.
- The aligned-basis argument was rechecked against [Conrad’s Modules over a PID](https://kconrad.math.uconn.edu/blurbs/linmultialg/modulesoverPID.pdf).

The full per-item handoff, provenance ledger, dependency changes, gates, and confidence limits are in [frontier-17-batch-3.notes.md](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/frontier-17-batch-3.notes.md).

One external blocker remains: repo-wide `depcheck` fails solely because the unrelated published item `rem-sine-period-arc-length-integrand-is-nonelementary` lacks `verification.sources_checked`. Batch 3 neither cites nor depends on it, so it was not edited.
